title: Production Hardening

secret_scan.gitignore_coverage: env files, key/pem/p12/pfx, wallet/, credentials/, crypto-config/ all covered

fabric_gateway_security_review.tls_hostname_verification: grpc.ssl_target_name_override set from configured peer host
fabric_gateway_security_review.identity_key_handling: cryptography.hazmat load_pem_private_key, type-checked EllipticCurvePrivateKey, ECDSA(SHA256) signing with low-S normalization
fabric_gateway_security_review.key_persistence: no plaintext key logging or caching introduced

backend_hardening.request_validation: Zod schemas on all mutating routes
backend_hardening.sql_injection: N/A — Prisma parameterized queries only, no raw SQL in P6 modules

mobile_hardening.hardcoded_secrets: none — only local-dev base URL defaults
mobile_hardening.native_platform_review: BLOCKED — no android/ or ios/ platform directories exist in either app (no APK/IPA build attempted, disclosed since P6.3)

database_migration_chain.alembic_chain: linear, single head: 001 -> 002 -> 003, verified via alembic history (no DB required)
database_migration_chain.live_upgrade_downgrade_upgrade_run: NOT EXECUTED — no PostgreSQL/Docker available in this environment

observability.metrics_tracing_backend: none exists (pre-existing, out of scope to add)

performance_notes: No caching on blockchain health proxy (negligible at current scale, not added speculatively); no N+1 patterns introduced (route touches no database)
documentation: P6.7/P6.8 reports serve as the required doc updates; no README/architecture staleness found
